design_fields.q1_rationale: The study does not use PISA plausible values as it focuses on modeling dichotomous item responses and process data.
design_fields.q2_rationale: The study explicitly states that it does not report the use of PISA sampling weights in the analysis.
design_fields.q3_rationale: The study analyzes individual student data without employing multilevel modeling or accounting for school clustering.
design_fields.q4_rationale: The study does not mention any external validation strategies and appears to rely solely on internal validation methods.
